description: Counts other titles by the same developer, counted against the full SteamSpy catalog snapshot, not only the candidate set, so a prolific studio filtered out at stage one does not look like a first-time solo developer.
signature: def compute_developer_catalog_size(frame: pd.DataFrame, catalog: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series
docstring:
Compute per-row developer catalog size.

Args:
    frame: The (candidate-scoped) normalized feature frame, indexed by appid, with a 'developer' column.
    catalog: The FULL bulk catalog frame (acquisition.build_catalog_frame's output for the whole run, not just survivors), also with a 'developer' column.

Returns:
    A pd.Series indexed like frame, giving count of OTHER apps (excluding the row's own appid) in catalog sharing the same developer string (exact, case-sensitive match on the raw developer field as reported -- no fuzzy/alias resolution, since Steam/SteamSpy developer strings are typically consistent for a given studio account).
preconditions: catalog contains every appid in frame (frame's candidates are a subset of the full catalog)
developer column is present in both frame and catalog
postconditions: A developer string of NaN/empty never matches another NaN/empty row as 'the same developer' (two apps both missing a developer field are not counted as sharing a developer)

edge_cases.input: A developer with only one title in the whole catalog (this row itself)
developer is NaN for this row
edge_cases.expected_behavior: 0 (undefined developer identity cannot be matched to any group, including other NaN rows)

edge_cases.input: The same developer string appears with different casing across two apps ('Team Cherry' vs 'team cherry')
edge_cases.expected_behavior: NOT matched as the same developer in v1 -- exact string match only; documented as a known limitation of this proxy feature, not silently fuzzy-matched, since fuzzy matching could introduce false groupings without a validated similarity method

unit_tests.name: test_counts_other_titles_excluding_self
unit_tests.description: A developer with 4 total catalog titles produces catalog_size=3 for each of that developer's rows.

unit_tests.name: test_nan_developer_yields_zero
unit_tests.description: A row with developer=NaN gets 0 regardless of other NaN-developer rows.

unit_tests.name: test_case_sensitive_no_match
unit_tests.description: 'Team Cherry' and 'team cherry' are not counted as the same developer.
